about: The one rulebook for when a deal is 'on'. pipeline/deal_state.py and site/deal-state.js must both pass every case here (tests/test_deal_state.py and tests/deal-state.test.mjs run them). Any other app that reads data/deals.json, such as the live foodish.ca app, should follow the same rules. Times are Edmonton wall-clock time. Days: 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday.

states.expired: valid_until is before today. Hide it.
states.upcoming: valid_from is after today. Hide it.
states.not_today: The deal doesn't run on this day.
states.all_day: Runs today with no start or end time. Show as 'All day', never as 'On now' (we don't know the restaurant's opening hours).
states.on_now: Its time window is open right now. Includes the after-midnight part of a deal that started yesterday (e.g. 9 pm to 2 am).
states.ended: Ran earlier today and is over.
states.scheduled: Runs on that day, when no time of day is given (e.g. looking at next Friday).

fields.days: list of 0-6; missing or empty means every day
fields.start: "HH:MM" 24-hour or null; null means from opening
fields.end: "HH:MM" 24-hour or null; null means until close (treated as midnight). An end at or before the start means the deal runs past midnight.
fields.valid_until: "YYYY-MM-DD" or missing; the deal still counts on that day
